description.value: Island Attitude Coffee is an OSM-listed cafe in the Tahsis area of west-coast Vancouver Island, one of the most remote cycling destinations in BC. The only associated website found is Westview Marina & Lodge, which operates a marina grillhouse, pub, and ice cream stand on the docks of Tahsis Inlet. Whether Island Attitude Coffee is a distinct business, a former name, or a coffee counter within the marina complex cannot be determined from available evidence.

address.value: 775 S Maquinna Dr, Tahsis, BC V0P 1X0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record names 'Island Attitude Coffee' as a cafe, but the discovered URL leads to Westview Marina & Lodge — a fishing charter and lodge operation in Tahsis, BC. The website makes no mention of 'Island Attitude Coffee' anywhere; the food/drink offering described is the 'Marina Grillhouse and Pub' with pub food and an ice cream stand. No cycling-specific amenities are mentioned on the website. The name mismatch is significant and the URL association cannot be confirmed as correct.
